detail.longDescription: Hello # Portland ! I'm a # trans mathematician who left the university for an abortive attempt at # homesteading . I ended up in an abusive situation and spent the rest of my money fleeing to the # PNW , where I'm looking to # GetFediHired and hopefully still live a # solarpunk lifestyle. In addition to broad experience with mathematics research and # teaching , I also write software. After years of writing # Python I've been getting into # Lua and # CPlusPlus . For a recent example of my work in both regards see https:// aten.cool/documents/papers/A%2 0rock-paper-scissors%20Mandelbrot%20set%20[2026].pdf I'm open to online and part-time work. Basically my goal is to work enough to support a modest lifestyle while keeping enough of my time open to do # math # research , learn new skills, and generally live a good life. This work should be contributing positively to my community, whether local to the # PDX or more globally construed. While I have both pure and applied knowledge of machine learning, this means # NoAI , no LLM, no crypto, etc. If you have an opportunity that might fit this description, please reach out here or via email (charlotte.aten@posteo.net). I'm very interested in sharing my knowledge outside the US and I may be able to work for less than typical for an American with my skill set.
